Replaying a stored transcript fails since the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a yarrow spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as an ember header.
